<thought>After searching the template catalog, I retrieved template reaction_id 182479, which corresponds to a Still‑Gennari‑type retrosynthetic transformation. Applying this template to the target molecule C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CO)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO produced a single set of three precursor molecules. These precursors are the polyether chain, an ethyl acetate fragment, and the protected sugar aldehyde. The required output format is a list of lists, each inner list containing the SMILES strings of the precursors.</thought>
<final_answer>[["C1COCCOCCOCCOCCOCCO1", "CCOC(C)=O", "C[C@@H]1[C@@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](CO)O[C@@H]1C=O"]]</final_answer>
